claims: The Artemis II Orion capsule is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II Orion capsule splashdown is scheduled on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II Orion capsule splashdown is scheduled at approximately 5:07 p.m. PDT (8:07 p.m. EDT).
The Artemis II Orion capsule is expected to land roughly 50-100 miles offshore from the coast of San Diego, California.
The USS John P. Murtha is the primary Navy ship designated to recover the Artemis II crew.
Live coverage of the Artemis II splashdown is available on NASA+ and YouTube.
The Artemis II crew will be extracted from the capsule by Navy teams.
The Artemis II crew will be taken via helicopter to the USS John P. Murtha shortly after landing.
The Artemis II splashdown concludes the 10-day flight test of the Orion spacecraft.
